FAT-1.scope: Host aliases and native rejected old reads; replacement bytes checked

FAT-2.scope: Host and native rejected writes; replacement bytes checked

FAT-3.scope: Regular-file source rename retains handle I/O; directory subset separately qualified

FAT-4.scope: Destination handle revoked, source handle reads own bytes after replacement; guest extended object identity unavailable

FAT-7.scope: Host name/slot reuse plus inherited local-generation exhaustion test; native internal generation exhaustion not injected

FAT-8.scope: Native duplicated descriptor rejects stale write and closes correctly

FAT-9.scope: Host zero open-count and clean unmount; native zero leaked fds/frames. No deferred storage model or cluster accounting at final close

FAT-10.scope: Host flush failure after deletion forces mount fail-stop and preserves valid close; arbitrary native I/O interruption NOT_RUN

scope: Passing witnesses prove replacement contents for exercised cases, not every concurrent/error schedule. Backend entry locations and generations are internal; no native identity ABI was fabricated.
